title: Cohomology and Betti numbers of derived residue-field fibres
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $i\in\mathbf Z$ and $x\in X$. Let $i_x:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to X$ be the canonical residue-field morphism. Define the derived-fibre cohomology vector space as the global sections on $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)$ of the degree-$i$ cohomology sheaf of $Li_x^*E$, where derived pullback is [def-pc-derived-pullback]; its scalar action is transported along $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x),\mathcal O)\cong\kappa(x)$. Define $\beta_i(E,x)$ to be its finite rank over $\kappa(x)$, equal to its dimension when finite dimensional, and zero otherwise (Mathlib finrank convention).

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories of Schemes
